description: This file defines an 'Integration' class for handling import and export of recipes, including methods for processing files, handling duplicates, and managing recipe data within a web application context. It interacts with models, external libraries, and handles various file formats and import scenarios.

classes.name: Integration
classes.description: A class providing methods for importing and exporting recipes, managing files, handling duplicates, and integrating with recipe models within a web application.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing import/export session, creating a keyword for the import process.

methods.name: do_export
methods.description: Exports a list of recipes into files, zipping if multiple, and returns a downloadable HTTP response.

methods.name: import_file_name_filter
methods.description: Filters files in zip archives based on filename; default includes all.

methods.name: do_import
methods.description: Handles importing recipes from provided files, managing duplicates, and updating import logs.

methods.name: handle_duplicates
methods.description: Checks for existing recipes with the same name and deletes duplicates if not importing duplicates.

methods.name: import_recipe_image
methods.description: Associates an image with a recipe, saving it with a unique filename.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a file object into a Recipe instance.

methods.name: split_recipe_file
methods.description: Abstract method to split a file containing multiple recipes into individual strings.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a Recipe object into a filename and content string.

methods.name: get_files_from_recipes
methods.description: Abstract method to generate files from a list of recipes.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Logs exceptions and prints traceback if in debug mode.

methods.name: get_export_file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for exported files based on current date.

methods.name: get_recipe_processed_msg
methods.description: Returns a string message summarizing a processed recipe.
